items.raw_excerpt: 4 月 25 日，元戎启行在第十九届北京国际汽车展览会（以下简称“北京车展”）举办发布会。会上，元戎 CEO 周光回顾创业初心，并介绍了公司在物理AI领域的最新进展与愿景。随后，元戎首席科学家阮翀发表首次公开演讲，系统分享公司在基座模型上的技术架构，此举被视为元戎抢占物理 AI 高地，定义下一代自动驾驶范式的里程碑。 元戎启行 CEO 周光演讲 周光：目标成为物理世界的 AI 基础设施 发布会开场，CEO 周光讲述了 2016 年创业初期一次发生在身边的交通事故。“当时我就在想，能否用 AI 技术去解救更多的生命。”周光表示，尽管当前自动驾驶并不完美，MPI（平均接管里程）在城市中仅为几十公里，但统计数据表明，目前的自动驾驶安全性已经是纯人类驾驶的数倍。“我们相信，在未来 2 到 3 年内，随着大模型对理解能力的持续增强，我们将实现真正安全的自动驾驶。” 周光为元戎启行定下了长期愿景：“我希望公司未来能成为物理世界的 AI 基础设施，就像通信、电力一样，成为支撑现实世界运行的基础能力。当人们谈及物理世界的智能时，元戎能够成为这一基础能力体系中的重要一环！” 首席科学家阮翀首次公开演讲，分享基座模型最新进展 作为前 DeepSeek 研发负责人、多模态技术核心研究员阮翀，在本次发布会上以元戎首席科学家的身份首次亮相，并围绕基座模型展开系统性分享，详细介绍公司在辅助驾驶认知能力构建方面的最新进展。 元戎启行首席科学家阮翀演讲 阮翀指出，随着辅助驾驶进入规模化量产阶段，以往依赖小模型发展的技术路径，导致系统稳定性与用户高频使用率提升缓慢，在复杂长尾场景中仍然容易出现能力波动，辅助驾驶体验尚未形成稳定可靠的信任基础。面向这一阶段性挑战，元戎提出以基座模型为核心的新一代技术路径。 基座模型将驾驶决策、场景理解与行为评估能力统一在同一架构中，通过更大的模型规模、更高的数据质量和更快的数

On April 25, DeepRoute.ai held a press conference at the 19th Beijing International Automotive Exhibition (hereinafter referred to as the "Beijing Auto Show"). At the event, DeepRoute CEO Zhou Guang reviewed the company's founding vision and introduced the latest progress and aspirations in the field of physical AI. Subsequently, DeepRoute's Chief Scientist Ruan Chong delivered his first public speech, systematically sharing the company's technical architecture for the foundation model. This move is seen as a milestone for DeepRoute in seizing the high ground of physical AI and defining the next generation of autonomous driving paradigms.  

**Speech by DeepRoute.ai CEO Zhou Guang**  
**Zhou Guang: Aiming to Become the AI Infrastructure of the Physical World**  

At the start of the press conference, CEO Zhou Guang recounted a traffic accident that occurred near him during the company's early days in 2016. "At that moment, I thought, can we use AI technology to save more lives?" Zhou Guang stated that although current autonomous driving is not perfect, with an average MPI (Miles Per Intervention) of only a few dozen kilometers in urban areas, statistical data shows that the safety of autonomous driving is already several times that of human-only driving. "We believe that in the next two to three years, as large models continue to enhance their understanding capabilities, we will achieve truly safe autonomous driving."  

Zhou Guang set a long-term vision for DeepRoute.ai: "I hope the company can become the AI infrastructure of the physical world in the future, just like communication and electricity, serving as the foundational capability supporting the operation of the real world. When people talk about intelligence in the physical world, I hope DeepRoute can become a key part of this foundational capability system!"  

**First Public Speech by Chief Scientist Ruan Chong**
excerpt_i18n.es: El 25 de abril, DeepRoute.ai celebró una conferencia en el 19º Salón Internacional del Automóvil de Pekín (en adelante, "Salón del Automóvil de Pekín"). Posteriormente, el científico jefe de DeepRoute, Ruan Chong, pronunció su primer discurso público, en el que compartió sistemáticamente la arquitectura técnica de la empresa en modelos base, un hito considerado como la toma de la delantera en la IA física y la definición del próximo paradigma de la conducción autónoma. items.raw_excerpt: 4月24日，2026第十九届北京国际汽车展览会隆重开幕。深圳佑驾创新科技股份有限公司（2431.HK）携系列新品亮相，重磅发布国内首款“真无图”L4级无人物流车小竹T5 Pro、座舱智能管家BamBam龙虾助手、全维智驾域控等系列产品。 本次北京车展，佑驾创新围绕AI for Mobility 、AI for Logistics、AI for Soul三大核心方向，全面展现公司全线产品与AI深度融合的创新成果，向行业传递构建汽车科技新范式的坚定决心。 全新小竹T5 Pro，国内首款“真无图”L4级无人物流车 当前，我国物流行业正加速向智能化、高效化、低碳化转型，无人物流车作为产业转型的核心载体，已逐步从示范运营向规模化商用跨越。但受制于传统技术路径的桎梏，部署慢、成本高、运营难等痛点长期制约行业发展。 在北京车展这一全球汽车产业核心盛会上，佑驾创新全新发布国内首款“真无图”L4级无人物流车小竹T5 Pro，凭借颠覆性的技术突破与商业化价值，成为本届车展为数不多发布的无人车产品，强势开启无人物流行业迈入“真无图”的商用新纪元。 国内首款“真无图”L4无人物流车小竹T5 Pro亮相北京车展 作为佑驾创新在物理AI领域的集大成之作，小竹T5 Pro并未延续传统无人车的迭代升级，而是面向万亿级无人物流市场而打造的革命性产品。其核心突破在于，以颠覆性技术重构无人物流商用逻辑，凭借“无图能力”在系统性能、场景泛化能力、部署效率与全生命周期综合成本四大核心维度实现质的飞跃。 传统无人物流车的落地部署，需先完成当地高精地图采集与适配，OTD（订单到交付）周期往往长达数周，严重制约商业化推进。而小竹T5 Pro凭借成熟的无图技术可彻底打破这一壁垒，将部署周期极大压缩，实现小时级快速部署，从车辆交付到正式运营全程高效便捷，实现“买了就能用”，极大提升订单交付效率，为客户快速创造商业价值。 佑驾

On April 24, the 19th Beijing International Automotive Exhibition (Auto China 2026) grandly opened. Shenzhen Youjia Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. (2431.HK) unveiled a series of new products, including the debut of China's first "truly mapless" L4-level unmanned logistics vehicle, Xiaozhu T5 Pro, the BamBam Lobster Assistant in-cabin smart butler, and full-stack intelligent driving domain controllers. At this year's Auto China, Youjia Innovation focused on three core directions—AI for Mobility, AI for Logistics, and AI for Soul—comprehensively showcasing the innovative achievements of deep integration between its full product line and AI, conveying the firm determination to establish a new paradigm in automotive technology to the industry.  

**New Xiaozhu T5 Pro: China's First "Truly Mapless" L4-Level Unmanned Logistics Vehicle**  
Currently, China's logistics industry is accelerating its transformation toward intelligence, efficiency, and low-carbon operations. As a core carrier of industrial transformation, unmanned logistics vehicles have gradually moved from demonstration operations to large-scale commercial use. However, constrained by traditional technical pathways, pain points such as slow deployment, high costs, and operational difficulties have long hindered industry development.  

At Auto China, a key global automotive industry event, Youjia Innovation launched the Xiaozhu T5 Pro, China's first "truly mapless" L4-level unmanned logistics vehicle. With its groundbreaking technological breakthroughs and commercial value, it became one of the few unmanned vehicle products released at this exhibition, strongly ushering in a new commercial era for the unmanned logistics industry to enter the "truly mapless" phase.  

**China's First "Truly Mapless" L4 Unmanned Logistics Vehicle Xiaozhu T5 Pro Debuts at Auto China**
excerpt_i18n.es: El 24 de abril se inauguró solemnemente la 19.ª Exposición Internacional del Automóvil de Pekín 2026. Shenzhen Youjia Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. (2431.HK) presentó una serie de nuevos productos, lanzando de manera destacada el primer vehículo logístico no tripulado L4 "sin mapa real" del país, el Xiaozhu T5 Pro, el asistente inteligente de cabina BamBam Lobster Assistant, y el controlador de dominio de conducción inteligente integral, entre otros productos. En esta Exposición del Automóvil de Pekín, Youjia Innovation se centró en tres direcciones principales: AI for Mobility, AI for Logistics y AI for Soul, mostrando de manera integral los resultados innovadores de la profunda integración de toda su línea de productos con la IA, transmitiendo a la industria la construcción de un nuevo paradigma tecnológico automotriz.

excerpt_i18n.en: I don’t need to tell you that AI is everywhere. Or that it is being used, increasingly, in hospitals. Doctors are using AI to help them with notetaking. excerpt_i18n.zh: 无需多言，人工智能已无处不在。它正越来越多地被应用于医院。医生借助AI辅助记录病历，基于AI的工具则通过筛查患者档案，标记出需要重点关注的人群。
